**Finding: Compliant** — no redline required.

The agreement grants TrueLink no audit, inspection, verification or records-examination right against Mortgage Logic.com:

- **§ 5–6 (Compensation / Documentation and Disputes)** — the reconciliation mechanic runs in *our* favour: we get supporting documentation on request and may contest charges, with no reciprocal audit right for TrueLink.
- **§ 8 (Client covenants)** — compliance, access-restriction and content warranties only; no verification or inspection right.
- **§ 10 (Confidentiality)** — no inspection mechanic.
- Text searches for "audit", "inspect", "records", "books" and "monitor" return nothing.

Two adjacent items were reviewed and cleared: § 8(f) lets TrueLink implement technical mechanisms on *its own* hosted Interface to prevent spamming/illegal use (not a usage audit, and no reach into our systems), and § 9 requires us to give reasonable access for TrueLink's own Y2K repairs at TrueLink's cost. Neither triggers the walk-away concern of unannounced audits or remote access to Customer systems, so there is no frequency, notice or cost-allocation exposure to fix.
